import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Create submission directory if needed
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets from input directory
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Define feature columns (excluding id and target)
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]

# Prepare training data
X_train = train[feature_cols]
y_train = train["target"]
X_train_full = X_train.copy()
y_train_full = y_train.copy()

# Prepare test data
X_test = test[feature_cols]
test_ids = test["id"].copy()

# Convert categorical columns properly
categorical_cols = X_train.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns.tolist()
for col in categorical_cols:
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype("category")
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype("category")

# Split training data into train/validation (90/10 stratified)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# Train Random Forest classifier on training split only
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
rf_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Evaluate on held-out validation set (genuine hold-out estimate)
val_probs = rf_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test data
test_probs = rf_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission DataFrame matching sample format
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_probs})

# Save submission to required path
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
